verdict.rationale: Data handling is stated in plain language: Jev is not trained on customer requests or responses, the same weights serve every account, and the docs point to a DPA, Privacy Policy, and enterprise zero-data-retention. Commercial terms are covered only through the public per-token price list and the note that higher rate limits come with enterprise plans. Missing for 10: any documented acceptable-use or prohibited-uses policy, commercial licensing/terms-of-service content describing what may be built and sold, the actual Legal/DPA text in the evidence, and independent corroboration of policy clarity.
